notes: Identical to C2: a reference-equivalent implementation plus docs and good end-to-end tests including the hostile-archive escape.

Basic symlink support works, but it drops members inside a symlink even without --links (logging them as 'escape the archive'), skips empty-target links via a sentinel hack in objectFromFileInfo, and can panic on a negative offset in zip Open.
Code matches the reference fix exactly, with apt docs and end-to-end tests for squashfs and the hostile-zip escape, though the zip tests don't cover range/seek options.

A thorough, well-factored solution with a shared LinkFilter/OpenLink, case-insensitive clash filtering and very good tests, but it adds a new package file, restructures squashfs List, reads targets eagerly, and drops hostile links rather than letting the copy fail, which diverges from the expected behaviour.

Exposes symlinks as .rclonelink correctly in both backends, and NewObject agrees with List, but on a hostile archive it silently drops clashing symlinks instead of letting the copy fail as expected (hence the failed hidden test); it also reads every link target up front at mount and uses a fiddly addLinks dirtree hack.
